boxes.name: 5-incinerator

boxes.name: 6-airport
boxes.note: Songshan Airport box (issue #134, user 2026-10-25). Edges from the measured airfield: the aerodrome boundary (OSM relation 5421750) spans lon 121.5384-121.5682 x lat 25.0617-25.0721 (runway 10/28 centreline 121.5396-121.5654, width tag 60 m, stopway to 121.5677). West edge 121.533 = the corridor box's east edge (shared segment 25.055-25.075 keeps the union connected and brings in the Dajia riverside frontage); south edge 25.055 = box A's north edge (shared 121.533-121.570); east 121.570 gives the stopway ~180 m of margin; north 25.078 takes in the Yingfeng riverside park, the levee and most of the Keelung River's width at this reach. The airfield itself is a SPECIAL SITE: the planner drops every procedural lot inside the aerodrome boundary (issue #134); the terminal + parking structures are issue #135.
